intent.goal: Establish machine-readable MNCS rights, provenance, and agent-governance context.
constraints: Keep the current legal license authoritative; the MNCS permissive-license text remains a candidate.
Keep legal rights separate from operational agent governance.
Preserve unknown, declared, observed, and verified evidence states.
Respect other sessions and modify only worktrees covered by this campaign's claims.
acceptance_criteria: Unresolved rights stay explicit and actionable.
Context identity changes when its declared profile changes.
provenance_expectations: Preserve artifact identities and transformation lineage.
Distinguish declared, observed, and verified facts.
write_scope: mncs-rights-provenance: governance profile, context resolver, candidate license, targeted tests.
